content_full:
Ina Lopez: Hi all — first day! I’m Ina (SRE), joining from NYC. Quick Qs: 1) MDM shows enrolled but my SSH access isn't working; 2) Who do I ask about ergonomic keyboard options? 3) Where's the checklist for SRE runbooks? Fun fact: I brew beer and brought a tiny bottle of saison for anyone in the NY office later :beers:
Onboarding-Bot: Welcome Ina! :tada: SSH keys are provisioned after IAM sync (usually 10-30m). If it still fails, run `it-ssh diag` and paste the output here. Ergonomic keyboard requests go through People Ops -> Hardware Request. SRE runbook checklist: Confluence -> SRE -> New Hire Onboard.
Marco Silva: welcome Ina! I’ll check IAM sync and escalate if needed — can you paste the output of `it-ssh diag` here? Also I have an extra USB-C ergonomic keyboard you can borrow for a week.
Priya Rao: hey Ina, welcome!! I’m your onboarding buddy. I’ll bring one of the split keyboards to demo at 3pm and we can try key layouts. Also added you to #sre, #oncall-ops, and #nyc-office.
Owen Park: pinged IT about key provisioning (ticket IT-9312). I’ll also drop a note in #lunch-plans for the NY folks — hope you can join for a quick welcome lunch at 12:30.
People-Ops: Hi Ina — sent hardware request link and ergonomic options form. If you want a permanent keyboard we can ship to your home or set aside in the NY office. Also sent calendar invite for a short 1:1 onboarding sync tomorrow.
Ina Lopez: pasted `it-ssh diag` output: `Error: key-not-found`. Marco, thanks for the loaner offer — I’ll take it today. Priya, 3pm demo works. See you all at lunch!
Onboarding-Bot: IT ticket IT-9312 created for SSH key provisioning. Facilities ticket FAC-5201 created to reserve demo keyboard. You will receive updates here.
Marco Silva: IT confirmed a missing IAM mapping; keys should land in ~15m. Welcome aboard Ina!
Ina Lopez: keys appeared  SSH works now. Thanks everyone for the quick help  can’t wait to meet folks and share that saison later :sparkles:
